text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from a race, I saw it! I 
actually saw it...! The look of distress 
on Doto-san's face as she struggled to 
progress...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The reason for her slump is that she 
hasn't reached her "growth spurt" yet. But 
she has no inkling of that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
With Trainer giving me a push, I went to 
tell them. However! Once an otaku starts 
talking, they just can't stop...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I ended up rattling off at top speed!! I 
interfered with my faveeee~~! None of that 
was helpful in the slightest, not even a 
bit!
